rationale: The subclass half of the cross-file overrides pin. `Multi < Base` is inheritance; `alpha` redeclares a member `Base` declares, so it is a verified override; `extra` is a new member and must NOT be an override; `shared` is declared by the base but not redeclared here, so it must not appear either. Without the companion only `Multi`'s own declarations are visible, and the honest answer for an unverifiable base is no override row at all — which is why this fixture opts in to `crossFileOverride` and the flat ones do not.
